forbidden_changes: approved UI redesign or navigation change

prechange_control.next_test: focused M4 controller regressions, complete source CI, Windows M4 runtime contracts, then existing exact-head gates
prechange_control.rollback_condition: any regression, manifest mismatch, changed-file scope violation, WB_ONLY violation, marketplace-write activation, or CI failure
prechange_control.rollback_action: do not advance fix/quantum-wb-release-r2; reset or discard corrective branch to base_exact_head

rtm.requirement: M4-01 dedicated managed automatic incoming directory
rtm.test: existing controller directory and settings contracts
rtm.pass_criterion: incoming, processing, completed, rejected and review-required remain under managed Quantum root

rtm.requirement: M4-02 supported stable XLSX/XLSM/ZIP admission only
rtm.pass_criterion: only stable supported regular files become candidates

rtm.requirement: M4-03 fail-closed symlink, size, traversal and state-tamper controls
rtm.action: preserve existing rejection controls and add state-record limit validation
rtm.test: symlink, traversal, state tamper and record-limit regressions
rtm.pass_criterion: unsafe or oversized state and paths are rejected without queue admission

rtm.requirement: M4-04 explicit authority and schema review
rtm.pass_criterion: no automatic queue admission without both controls

rtm.requirement: M4-05 reuse existing SequentialImportQueue and run_import worker
rtm.test: static integration contract and complete source CI
rtm.pass_criterion: existing queue and worker remain the only import path

rtm.requirement: M4-06 one SHA-256 binds preview, claim, processing, duplicate archive and completion
rtm.action: add mandatory post-move duplicate hash verification and fail-closed quarantine
rtm.pass_criterion: a duplicate changed during move is rejected and never recorded as a valid duplicate

rtm.requirement: M4-07 bounded atomic deduplication and outcome state
rtm.action: introduce deterministic record cap, terminal-record pruning and fail-closed active-capacity handling
rtm.test: bounded records, deterministic pruning, active-capacity exhaustion and oversized-state load regressions
rtm.pass_criterion: records never exceed the declared cap and active records are never silently removed

rtm.requirement: M4-08 crash recovery and cancellation finalization
rtm.pass_criterion: interrupted files return for retry and cancelled rows finalize rejected

rtm.requirement: M4-09 existing one-click desktop polling without UI redesign
rtm.test: existing shell, mixin and navigation contracts

rtm.requirement: M4-10 WB_ONLY, Ozon deferred, Gatekeeper disconnected, marketplace writes disabled
rtm.test: source CI, M7, M8 and manifest checks
rtm.pass_criterion: all four boundaries remain explicit and enforced

rtm.requirement: M4-11 controlled publication over the validated M4 exact head
rtm.action: publish only on isolated corrective branch until all exact-head gates pass
rtm.pass_criterion: corrective ancestry starts at 050ce0c and contains only allow-listed changes

rtm.requirement: M4-12 no claim above evidence ceiling
rtm.action: keep L4/L5 and release claims excluded
rtm.pass_criterion: no installed or physical-user PASS is claimed

rtm.action: add executable tests for both discovered defects and negative controls
rtm.pass_criterion: tests fail on base M4 behavior and pass only after the corrective implementation

rtm.action: append R99 overlay and extend the canonical overlay loader
rtm.pass_criterion: effective manifest equals the exact tracked tree

rtm.action: run focused Linux/Windows M4 and existing mandatory workflows on one immutable head
rtm.pass_criterion: all required checks succeed on the same corrective head
